candidate.answerReason: The sample proportion meeting the standard is 40/50=80%. Applying that proportion to 1200 students gives an estimated 960 students.

methods.label: Apply the sample percentage
methods.explanation: The proportion meeting the standard in the sample is \(40/50=80\%\). The estimated number meeting the standard in the school is \(1200\times80\%=960\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 estimation of population counts and elementary percentage arithmetic.
